doc.title: Alan Raph interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001

title: Three favorite trombone players
summary: Raph names Buddy Morrow, Urbie Green and Brookmeyer as favorites.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Who are your three favorite trombone players?
Who I love. Buddy is 82 years old, he’s still out with the Tommy Dorsey band. And I like Buddy a lot. Urbie Green. And Brookmeyer.
And running very close to them are quite a few other guys. But those three I suppose I would have to say would be my three favorite.
